entry.question: Are you family of {name}? We can guide you through filing a claim. We need to verify it's you.
shell.saved: Saved. You can return anytime — there's no rush.
otp.title: Let's verify it's you
otp.help: We've sent a one-time code to the nominee's phone {mobile} — not this phone. Please enter it below.
otp.no_nominee: We couldn't reach a nominee's phone. Please call us and we'll help you file.
otp.error_invalid: That code didn't work. Please check it and try again, or call us for help.
otp.error_rate_limit: Please wait a little before requesting another code.
relationship.title: Your relationship to {name}
relationship.help: This helps us guide the next steps. Take your time.
relationship.error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again, or call us — we'll help.
document.title: The death certificate
document.help: You can upload it now, or save and upload it within 7 days. There's no rush.
document.saved: Saved. You can return to upload anytime within 7 days.
document.uploaded: Document uploaded. We'll review it — there's nothing more you need to do.
document.upload_failed: The upload didn't go through. You can try again, or upload later — there's no rush.
document.permission_needed: Camera access is needed to take a photo. You can choose a PDF instead.
nominee.title: Nominee details
nominee.help: Please check these details. If anything looks wrong, call us — we'll help correct it.
nominee.name: Name
nominee.empty: No nominee details are on file yet. Please call us — we'll help.
nominee.load_error: We couldn't load these details right now. Please call us — we'll help.
ack.title: We're with you
ack.body: Thank you. Verification usually takes 2–3 weeks, and a field worker will visit. We'll keep you updated — there's nothing more you need to do right now.
readback.identity.title: Identity read-back — confirm before filing
readback.identity.script: I'd like to confirm a few details before we file the claim. Am I right that this is for {name}? Please confirm the name is correct.
readback.nominee.title: Nominee summary read-back — advisory only
readback.nominee.script: For our records, {name} has {count} registered nominee(s). This is only to help — it does not affect filing the claim.
